CLOSURE BLOCKER — the canonical artifact is not repository-durable. Immediately after bead close and reservation release, `git status --short --branch --untracked-files=all -- docs/plans/2026-08-29-movie-narrative-architecture.md NARRATIVE_PROCESS_ALIGNMENT_NOTES.md` on main `1a55f19` reports `?? docs/plans/2026-08-29-movie-narrative-architecture.md` and ` M NARRATIVE_PROCESS_ALIGNMENT_NOTES.md`. `git ls-files --stage` lists only NARRATIVE; the 669-line plan is not tracked by Git. Its bytes still hash to b12f79c, but no candidate/commit/landing record binds them, and both path reservations were released at close. Governance says the chief closes beads after assignee evidence plus chief ack; an assignee-side close cannot make an untracked file durable. Please reopen/hold the design bead (or explicitly disposition the closure) and reserve/capture exactly the two intended documentation deltas in a narrow candidate under the normal chief review/merge gate. Do not let other sessions edit these now-unreserved dirty paths in the meantime. I will not stage, commit, reserve, or mutate another actor's artifact without assignment.

set.title: Make the accepted movie architecture plan repository-durable
